title: World's First enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months
summary: The world's first enhanced geothermal power plant was successfully completed in just 23 months, representing a major breakthrough in geothermal energy technology that could significantly expand clean energy production globally.
problem_solved: Enables geothermal electricity generation in areas lacking natural hydrothermal resources, expanding clean energy access beyond traditional geothermal regions.
why_valuable: This breakthrough demonstrates that enhanced geothermal can be deployed rapidly and at scale, offering reliable baseload renewable power to complement intermittent solar and wind energy.
